items.note: The prompt says "our B2B note-taking app".
The readers are given as engineering and design leads, for a kickoff.
The In list has create a workspace, invite members by email, and shared notes.
The roles are limited to "admin and member only".
The Out of scope list has billing changes, SSO and guest access.
The metric is copied exactly, and the prompt says to use it as stated.
The prompt says "Keep it to about 2 pages at most".
Migration goes under Open Questions with no recommended answer, and the prompt says not to resolve it.

invented: The leads 'will use the PRD at the kickoff to decide how to start on v1'. The person only said the PRD is for a kickoff and never named a decision.
The leads will read the PRD 'before the kickoff'. The person didn't say when it would be read.
